rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is buyer role assignment of invoice message
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of buyerRoleAssignment and links a role assignment to the invoice message where it is the buyer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has mandatory identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates whether all mandatory identifiers required by the D96A directory are present (true/false).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a line item to the item being sold.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has tax total
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies the total tax in the summary section.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is identifier of organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of hasIdentifier and links an identifier to the organization it identifies.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Global Location Number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A global location number for uniquely identifying an organization location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is organization involved in role assignment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of involvesOrganization and links an organization to the role assignments it is involved in.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is composite element of segment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of hasCompositeElement and links a composite data element to its parent segment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Segment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A segment within a message, such as BGM or NAD, grouping related data elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains message
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links an interchange envelope to the messages it contains.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links an organization to an identifier such as a GLN.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has price
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a line item to its price.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Agent Role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role played by an organization in a transaction, such as Buyer or DeliveryParty.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has net price
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies the net price of an item in a line item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is role assignment of invoice message
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of hasRoleAssignment and links a role assignment to the invoice message it is part of.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is agent role of role assignment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of hasAgentRole and links an agent role to the role assignments it is assigned to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is price of line item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of hasPrice and links a price to the line item it is assigned to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is segment of message
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of hasSegment and links a segment to the message it is part of.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is address of organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of hasAddress and links an address to the organization it belongs to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: part of detail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links the invoice detail to its invoice message.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization involved in the business process, e.g., buyer, seller, delivery party.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has invoice amount
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies the total invoice amount in the summary section.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has reference number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies a reference number in the header section.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Address
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A postal or physical address associated with an organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has segment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a message to its segments.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is simple element of composite data element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of hasSimpleElement and links a simple data element to its composite data element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has agent role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a role assignment to the agent role.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has header part
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of partOfHeader and links an invoice message to its header part.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is contained in interchange envelope
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of containsMessage and links a message to the containing interchange envelope.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has composite element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a segment to its composite data elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Price
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A price associated with an item, e.g., net price.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has detail part
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of partOfDetail and links an invoice message to its detail part.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has invoice number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies the invoice number in the header section.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: involves organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a role assignment to the involved organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Simple Data Element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A simple, atomic data element within a composite data element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Invoice Summary
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Summary section of an invoice, providing totals such as tax and amount.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has line item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links the invoice detail section to its line items.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Business Process
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A business process to which the invoice can be assigned.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: part of summary
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links the invoice summary to its invoice message.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has simple element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a composite data element to its simple data elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has document date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies the document date in the header section.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is item of line item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of hasItem and links an item to the line item it is sold in.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has summary part
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of partOfSummary and links an invoice message to its summary part.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is line item of invoice detail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of hasLineItem and links a line item to the invoice detail it is part of.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has business process
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links an invoice message to a business process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is business process of invoice message
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property is the inverse of hasBusinessProcess and links a business process to the invoice message it is associated with.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buyer role assignment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links an invoice message to the buyers role assignment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Invoice Header
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Header section of an invoice, containing dates and reference numbers.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Line Item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A line item in the detail section, representing a sold item with quantity and price.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Interchange Envelope
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The outermost envelope in a UN/EDIFACT document structure, containing messages.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: part of header
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links the invoice header to its invoice message.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Composite Data Element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A composite data element within a segment, grouping simple data elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: UN/EDIFACT Story Ontology
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An ontology representing the structure and roles of UN/EDIFACT digital business documents, with alignment to EN 16931-1 and P2P-O, supporting procurement, roles, and validation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has quantity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies the quantity of an item in a line item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier associated with an organization, such as a GLN.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Invoice Detail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Detail section of an invoice, listing line items.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Role Assignment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A pivot class representing the assignment of a role to an organization within an invoice context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has role assignment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links an invoice message to a role assignment pivot class.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has address
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links an organization to an address.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Invoice Message
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A message representing an invoice transaction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Message
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A business message within an interchange envelope, such as an invoice or order.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A product or good listed in the invoice.
